criteria.silhouette_scale: Compact folded-metal oil tin, open handle, offset filler and broad readable label; proportions extracted into fidelity targets.
criteria.implementable_geometry: Cuboid body/handle, 45-degree shoulder strips and small faceted cap; tiny edge wear stays in texture.
criteria.mechanics_clearance: Both handle legs supported by shoulder; cap sits beside handle and remains accessible. Static sealed item, no animation needed.
criteria.period_materials: Blue-gray metal, thin steel seams and brass closure match engine family; enamel marking avoids modern plastic/military jerrycan look.
criteria.family_consistency: Same tin/hardware on all four variants, differentiated only by matching enamel badge.
criteria.controls_readability: Gray ring, dark drop, amber flame and green oil-can symbols distinguish empty/crude/fuel/lube without tiny text.
criteria.gameplay_scope: Only appearance; original item IDs/capacity/stack sizes unchanged.
